name: Guadarrama (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Guadarrama (a lion and the letters F.VI on red).
history: Municipal flag of Guadarrama; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
